name: Devin
author: Nazeeh
summary: Hands coding tasks to Devin through a remote MCP deployment, then creates sessions, checks progress, and sends follow-up instructions.
starterPrompt: Create a Devin session for this coding task, track its progress, and summarize what needs my review when it finishes.
usageNote: Connect only a remote MCP deployment you control, and review the session output before accepting code changes.
